relations.statement: Separability, collapse, holding two and representative lists are carried by the isomorphism with no hypothesis (forward only; the reverse is application to the exchanged structure and is not stated as a theorem).
relations.hypotheses: none beyond an isomorphism of structures

relations.statement: Collapse is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, so it is an equivalence relation on admitted data.
Holding two needs two data, a form and an instance, so its first stage is four events from the empty regime and two from each Lean reading regime.

lemmas.statement: Holding two is carried by isomorphism: holdsTwo R implies holdsTwo (iso R).
Two representative lists of one regime have the same length (class count). OPEN in Lean (T-1).

near_misses.claim: Reverse iso transport of separability as a stated theorem.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Only forward statements exist; the reverse is application to the exchanged structure and is not stated.
Instance or rule admission can end holding two; only supply, datum, form and requirement admissions keep separable pairs.

open_obligations: No source declarations are listed, so no existing citations are made.
Ground the generators, the admission operations, with typed colours.
Class count as a number depends on the collapse decision (X-1).
Lean elaboration of holdsTwo_iso, twoness_needs_four and separable_iso is unverified.
Reverse-direction iso theorems are not stated.
